hypothesis: Buried normal faults under basin fill produce weak-amplitude but phase-stable magnetic contacts across wavelengths; amplitude-independent multi-scale gradient-phase congruency detects them where amplitude-threshold Hessian/tilt detectors miss.
mechanism: 5 magnetic bands (mag_anom 1, rtp 2, tmi_hg 3, tmi_vg 9, tmi 14) -> Gaussian gradients at 1.5/3.0/6.0 px -> phase vectors exp(j*theta) -> normalized resultant length R + amp-weighted persistence -> per-band phase-congruency strength -> rank01 cross-band average + 300m structure-tensor coherence gate. Added to 19 core bands in HGB LOQO; control = 19 core alone.
named_non_fault_mimic: Intrusive/lithologic magnetic contacts, sedimentary susceptibility contrasts, USGS GeoDAWN flight-line levelling seams (azimuth 90°)
inputs: data/bridge/existing_faults.tif catalogue mask only for holdout split/label/mask
signature: PC = |sum_k exp(j theta_k)|/K * (sum_k amp_k * R_k)/sum_k amp_k; coherence via 2*|Jxx-Jyy,Jxy|/tr
validation: buffered_component_draw hide 20% segments + 3px buffer, 4 quadrants, visible-only catalogue features, pixel-exact masking, pooled DTI alpha0.2 beta0.8 R300m, 20km block bootstrap 1000 draws, seeds 20/30
promotion: Require candidate >0.152718 HOLDOUT-DTI on seed 20 and literal rho <=0.90 + like-for-like dot overlap <=0.70 vs dot_fields; dense continuous surfaces (support fraction >0.20) excluded from dot-overlap literal reading per two_phase protocol, reported separately; need selector approval, 0 automatic slots.
